headline: Senior Software Engineer — Java Back End
summary: Senior software engineer with nine years of experience designing Java back-end services for payments and banking. I lead code reviews, set testing standards and mentor junior developers while still writing production code. I work remotely from Biliran with distributed agile teams and own services from design through deployment on AWS.
highlights: Cut a nightly settlement batch from five hours to 70 minutes by redesigning its SQL and splitting it into parallel jobs.
Raised automated test coverage on the core payments service from 38% to 81% and made passing builds a merge requirement.
Mentored six junior developers; four now own services of their own.
skills: Automated testing with JUnit and Mockito
Agile development in Scrum and Kanban teams
JavaScript and Vue.js for internal tools
Debugging and profiling with IntelliJ and VisualVM

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Own the settlement and reconciliation services that process merchant payouts for about 4,000 small merchants.
Run design reviews and sprint planning for a team of seven, and keep estimates honest with data from past sprints.
Moved three services onto AWS with the platform team, writing the runbooks the support team now uses.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built Java services for bills-payment partners and the SQL reports finance used for daily reconciliation.
Found and fixed a race condition in duplicate-payment detection by reproducing it under load and stepping through it in the debugger.
Built a small Vue.js console that let operations staff re-run failed transactions safely.

experience.title: Junior Java Developer
bullets: Maintained Java desktop and web modules for cooperative bookkeeping clients in Eastern Visayas.
Wrote the SQL migration scripts that moved twelve clients from spreadsheets to a shared database.
